subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan (Skyline Health)
messages:
From: Claire Zhou <c.zhou@skylinehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@skylinehealth.com>, Skyline Health Procurement <procurement@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan (Skyline Health)

Hi Nikhil / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our leadership was impressed with the latency/cost profile you showed. Procurement asked that we formalize a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on milestones, exec sponsors, and an evaluation plan before our Q4 board review. I've attached the MAP template we use internally.

High-level asks from my side:
- Introduce your exec sponsor (VP/CTO level) who will own outcomes and escalation.
- A proposed evaluation plan (tests, pass/fail criteria) and who on your side will own it.
- Target close date and any gating items for procurement (SOC 2 evidence, data residency notes).

Can we aim for a kickoff call this week? I'm flexible Thu/Fri morning PT. Evan from procurement is copied to loop in the legal/terms conversation.

Thanks,
Claire
Director, Digital Strategy | Skyline Health
Attachments: Skyline_MAP_Template.xlsx
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <c.zhou@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan (Skyline Health)

Claire — really appreciate the clear asks and the template. Attaching a short Redwood-drafted MAP that maps your milestones to owners and a proposed timeline.

Quick notes:
- Exec sponsor: Rishi Malhotra, VP of Engineering (cc'd). Rishi will own executive alignment and be the escalation path for SLA/QoS commitments.
- Evaluation owner: Marissa Cole (cc'd) will run the hands-on evals with your team and coordinate test cases (latency, failover, privacy).
- Procurement gating: we can provide SOC 2 summary and a scoped access log extract; Marissa will kick off evidence requests.

Proposed target close: 2027-12-15 to align with your Q4 board cycle. If that works, we can use a weekly MAP sync (30m) and a final eval window (10 business days) prior to sign.

Available for a kickoff Thu 11/4 09:00 - 11:00 PT or Fri 11/5 08:00 - 10:00 PT. Let me know what works and I will send calendar invites + a HubSpot link with the mutual milestones.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/34567/rdw-2027-1347
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <c.zhou@skylinehealth.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan (Skyline Health)

Claire — adding a few concrete items for the evaluation plan so we have clarity coming into the kickoff:
- Eval window: 10 business days (can be extended based on appliance/health checks).
- Test matrix: perf (p95 latency at target QPS), throughput (tokens/sec), failure recovery (simulated zone failure), and model parity on our curated open models.
- Success criteria: p95 latency < 250ms at 4 concurrent clients; no functional regressions on 95% of prompt suite.

On procurement evidence: can Evan confirm the specific SOC 2 artifact they need (full report vs. summary)? We can produce an export of access/audit logs for the evaluation subset.

I'll prepare a short runbook for the eval owner and share before the kickoff — it will include test harness links and a Slack channel we can use.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Zhou <c.zhou@skylinehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@skylinehealth.com>, Skyline Health Procurement <procurement@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan (Skyline Health)

Thanks — that all looks reasonable. Evan (procurement) — we're looking for a SOC 2 Type II summary and evidence that logs can be shared for a scoped evaluation window. Can you confirm acceptable format?

For executive outcomes: our VP Product and CTO want to see a one-pager mapping Redwood to three Q4 outcomes: 1) reliable STT/LLM inference under burst loads, 2) 30% token cost reduction vs current provider, 3) controls for PHI handling in derivatives. Rishi — if you can commit to an exec-level outcome statement we can put that into the MAP and present to our board.

I'll take Thu 11/4 09:30 PT for kickoff if that works for you all.

Best,
Claire
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <c.zhou@skylinehealth.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan (Skyline Health)

Claire — thanks for the clear asks. I'm happy to serve as the exec sponsor for this engagement. High level commitment from Redwood:
- Outcome statement: Redwood will enable Skyline Health to run reliable, low-latency LLM inference at production scale while reducing per-token costs by at least 25% within the evaluation window, contingent on agreed traffic patterns and model selection.
- Escalation path: day-to-day eval issues -> Marissa (SSE) -> Nikhil (AE) -> Rishi (exec sponsor). If there are platform-SLA or security blockers, I'll coordinate cross-functional resources.
- Quarterly outcomes: we'll map milestones to your three priorities and provide a single-page RACI inside the MAP.

Looking forward to the kickoff Thu 11/4 09:30 PT. I've blocked 30 minutes and will bring our reliability lead if needed.

-Rishi
VP, Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <c.zhou@skylinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@skylinehealth.com>, Skyline Health Procurement <procurement@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan (Skyline Health)

All — perfect, kickoff confirmed Thu 11/4 09:30 PT. I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a link to the shared MAP doc. Action items before kickoff:
- Marissa: upload runbook + test harness links to the shared Drive (before Thu 9am PT).
- Claire / Evan: confirm SOC 2 summary format and procurement gating items.
- Rishi: if you have a one-line exec outcome you'd like in the MAP, paste it in the Drive doc; otherwise we'll use the commitment above.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this moving.

-Nikhil
Attachments referenced: SOC2_Summary.pdf
